requested_changes.title: Formal LIVE proof still trusts selected scalar summaries and self-declared Root/message documents
requested_changes.evidence: Fact sources are only selected pointer equality inside product_original_refs; there is no required typed full DB/JSONL/process/Job witness and replay for the frozen six assertions. H08 is booleans plus a version-matrix selected_runtime, P01 is booleans plus installed_cli='researchos', U02 is two claimed hashes plus tests_native_exit==0. _invocations accepts any integer native_exit without binding an original exec/wait result and frozen lane outcome. Root grant/registration and the fifth-part delivery are schema/actor/ref/string checks, without an original Root tool-action/capture envelope proving execution or review delivery. This is a static missing consumer contract finding; absent actual producers are separately OPEN, not a failed live run.
requested_changes.requested_fix: Define the minimal fixed Root capture ABI and consume it fail-closed: exact original tool input/result and terminal/native bridge per lane, source/runtime/current-scope/grant and owned Job/process-settlement identity, actual immutable full DB/JSONL/action/file/test witnesses tied to the same task/Goal/Run/ToolEffect. Derive H08/P01/U02 predicates from those actual witnesses; do not accept only a producer-authored scalar projection. Bind the independent fifth part and Root issuance to original non-author review/delivery observations and the same reviewed refs. If a typed producer/witness is absent or unsupported, return OPEN/NOT_RUN. Keep all additional fields as proposals pending Root adoption.
